title: Austin's Concise Leap Day Meeting
summary:
*   City leaders held a very brief meeting on Leap Day.
*   The sole purpose was to formally adjourn a previously recessed session.
*   No new business was discussed, and no policy decisions were made.
*   The meeting concluded immediately, with no further actions taken.
transcript:
CITY OF AUSTIN, TEXAS
MINUTES OF THE CITY COUNCIL
CITY OF AUSTIN, TEXAS
Recessed Meeting
of
February 29, 1960
March 1, 1960
COUNCIL CHAMBERS, CITY HALL
Mayor Miller called the recessed meeting to order. Roll Call: Present: Councilmen Bechtol,
Palmer, Perry, White, Mayor Miller Absent: None The Council met briefly to adjourn
formally the recessed meeting of February 29, 1960. No other action was taken. ADJOURNMENT
The Council then adjourned.
